name: What are common financing options for investment properties?

mainEntity.name: What are common financing options for investment properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common financing options for investment properties include conventional loans, FHA loans (for owner-occupied multi-family up to four units), portfolio loans, and private money loans. Conventional loans often require a higher down payment than primary residences and may have different interest rates. Some investors also utilize hard money loans for short-term projects like flips. The choice of financing depends on your creditworthiness, the property type, and your investment strategy, with lenders often requiring specific debt-to-income ratios and reserves. Exploring different loan products early can significantly impact your purchasing power.
